parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query, in millisecond timestamp.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud instance ID.

parameters.name: InstanceList
parameters.description: The list of instance IDs for batch filtering.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description: The metric by which data is sorted. Default value: **ByteCount**, which sorts data by traffic volume.

parameters.name: OtherCity
parameters.description: The remote city.

parameters.name: OtherCountry
parameters.description: The remote country.

parameters.name: OtherIp
parameters.description: The remote IP address.

parameters.name: OtherIsp
parameters.description: The remote ISP.

parameters.name: OtherPort
parameters.description: The remote port.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description: The protocol number.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Internet traffic to query.

parameters.name: Sort
parameters.description: The sort order of traffic data.

parameters.name: TopN
parameters.description: The number of top-ranked entries to display. Default value: **10**, which displays the top 10 entries. Maximum value: **100**.

parameters.name: TupleType
parameters.description:
The tuple type of the query. Valid values:
- **1**: one-tuple.
- **2**: two-tuple.
- **5**: five-tuple.

parameters.name: UseMultiAccount
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use the multi-account management feature. Default value: **false**, which indicates that the feature is not used.
> The multi-account management feature is not enabled by default. To use this feature, contact your account manager to request access.
